essence: Effective worship of this circle requires sustained application of meditation.
The practice makes both familiar and unfamiliar languages of many forms perceptible.
The languages are heard spontaneously by the self, for the self, and within the self.
The attainment yields a rejuvenated, divinely beautiful form like a second god of love.
By destroying the wind and related forces through speech, one stands silent like a mute.
